decisions.pass: no unresolved critical issue; citations and key numbers checked
decisions.revise: critical issue fixable within remaining sources and budget
decisions.insufficient: key fact missing, conflict unresolved, source unread or budget short

reviewer_output.invalid_output: one format retry (counts toward the 8 sends); still invalid → insufficient

deterministic_checks.module: agents/review_checks.py (vendored from D's W05 draft, logic unchanged)
deterministic_checks.merge_rule: final decision = stricter of model and rules (insufficient > revise > pass); a deterministic critical issue turns a model pass into revise
deterministic_checks.also_on_insufficient_drafts: rules run without a model call so wrong facts are recorded

budget.shared: Researcher and Reviewer share one BudgetGate per job
budget.over_budget: never skips review: a draft that cannot be reviewed ends insufficient_evidence, never succeeded

revision.context: fresh compact conversation: previous draft + review_feedback + observation digests

publication.publish_path: human approval + immutable report version + Storage PDF (W07); the model has no publish permission

draft_format_cr_adopted.status: adopted by the lead's assistant 2026-10-15 — lead to confirm
